name: Request guidance on newborn care and administration
description: Users requested information, guidance, or project components regarding the general care, clinical management, or administrative systems for newborns and infants. The requests varied from seeking specific health advice on feeding, sleep, and post-procedure recovery to asking for research objectives and objectives for developing newborn management software or hospital databases.
